## Projects

- **EnergySwap AI** — AI Agents and blockchain for peer-to-peer energy trading. Stack: FastAPI, Solana, React, Python. [GitHub](https://github.com/Gaurav-612/energy-agent_agent) | [Demo](https://www.loom.com/share/21c1b5c36ff54062bef832b592f94a1d)
- **RAG Driving Instructor** — AI instructor for Ontario driving knowledge using retrieval-augmented generation. Stack: NVIDIA NIM, LangChain. [GitHub](https://github.com/Gaurav-612/rag-driving-instructor) | [Demo](https://rag-driving-instructor.streamlit.app/)
- **Text to SQL** — Natural language interface for querying databases. Stack: Google Gemini, SQLite. [GitHub](https://github.com/Gaurav-612/textToSql)
